temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he has been hiding something and that he is in some trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is hiding something important from him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; his suspicion is confirmed, and he learns the hidden matter is that Jonathan is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan was hiding something because he is in trouble and did not want to worry Christian.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious and suspicious, then worried and concerned after the admission.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To learn more about the trouble Jonathan mentioned and consider how to respond.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated and he does not want to drag Christian into it, but he eventually admits he could use support and resources to get out of the mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is in trouble and may need help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Jonathan's trouble is complicated, but he is willing to accept Christian's support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan needs support and resources to get out of his trouble, and Christian can help him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer help and provide support and resources to Jonathan.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot say for sure whether it is illegal, that he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but that he did not do anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan's trouble may be related to criminal activity or wrong people.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; his concern about criminal involvement is partly confirmed, but Jonathan denies doing anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may have been involved with wrong people, but he claims he did not commit any illegal acts; the situation may involve criminal elements.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate the matter discreetly without alarming Jonathan and find out what is really going on.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed; someone is trying to set him up. Christian tells Jonathan this and says he will gather evidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan may be involved with wrong people but likely did not act illegally, and that further investigation is needed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; the investigation indicates Jonathan is innocent and is being framed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed by someone, and Christian needs to clear his name.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gather evidence to prove Jonathan's innocence and clear his name.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian identifies that the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan, and he tells Jonathan this.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is being framed and is gathering evidence to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he now believes the person responsible is someone he and Jonathan both know and trust.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The real culprit is a trusted person close to both of them, and this is a betrayal.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice.
